note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). The total and every value are hypothetical placeholders labelled as such. One supplied datum is replaced by the alternative datum supplied in the preset; only that piece's length changes and the old value stays traceable. No share rule or legal doctrine is stated and nothing is attributed, ranked or decided.
